1700: a prolonged form of μόχθος; of me:--me, mine, my.
1702: from ἐν and παίζω; to jeer at, i.e. deride:--mock.
1703: from ἐμπαίζω; a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher:--mocker, scoffer.
1704: from ἐν and περιπατέω; to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons:--walk in.
1705: from ἐν and the base of πλεῖστος;to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively):--fill.
1706: from ἐν and πίπτω; to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with:--fall among (into).
1707: from ἐν and πλέκω; to entwine, i.e. (figuratively) involve with:--entangle (in, self with).
1708: from ἐμπλέκω; elaborate braiding of the hair:--plaiting.
1709: from ἐν and πνέω; to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon):--breathe.
1710: from ἐν and πορεύομαι; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade:--buy and sell, make merchandise.
1713: from ἐν and the base of πορεύομαι; a (wholesale) tradesman:--merchant.
1714: from ἐν and (to blow a flame); to enkindle, i.e. set on fire:--burn up.
1715: from ἐν and πρός; in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time):--against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.
1716: from ἐν and πτύω; to spit at or on:--spit (upon).
1717: from a compound of ἐν and φαίνω; apparent in self:--manifest, openly.
1718: from ἐμφανής; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words):--appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.
1719: from ἐν and φόβος; in fear, i.e. alarmed:--affrighted, afraid, tremble.
1720: from ἐν and (to puff) (compare φύω); to blow at or on:--breathe on.
1721: from ἐν and a derivative of φύω; implanted (figuratively):--engrafted.
1722: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between εἰς and ἐκ); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc.:--about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, (speedi-)ly, X that, X there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different) preposition.
1723: from ἐν and a derivative of ἀγκάλη; to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace:--take up in arms.
1724: from ἐν and ἅλς; in the sea, i.e. marine:--thing in the sea.
1725: from ἐν and ἀντί; in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of:--before.
1726: neuter of ἐναντίος; (adverbially) in the presence (view) of:--before, in the presence of.
1727: from ἔναντι; opposite; figuratively, antagonistic:--(over) against, contrary.
1728: from ἐν and ἄρχομαι; to commence on:--rule (by mistake for ἄρχω).
1729: from a compound of ἐν and δέω (in the sense of lacking); deficient in:--lacking.
1731: from ἐν and δεικνύω; to indicate (by word or act):--do, show (forth).
1732: from ἐνδείκνυμι; indication (abstractly):--declare, evident token, proof.
1733: from (the neuter of) εἷς and δέκα; one and ten, i.e. eleven:--eleven.
1735: third person singular present of a compound of ἐν and δέχομαι; (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible):--can (+ not) be.
1736: from a compound of ἐν and δῆμος; to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively):--be at home (present).
1737: a prolonged form of ἐνδύω; to invest (with a garment):--clothe in, wear.
1738: from ἐν and δίκη; in the right, i.e. equitable:--just.
1739: from a compound of ἐν and a derivative of the base of δῆμος; a housing in (residence), i.e. structure:--building.
1741: from ἐν and δόξα; in glory, i.e. splendid, (figuratively) noble:--glorious, gorgeous(-ly), honourable.
1742: from ἐνδύω; apparel (especially the outer robe):--clothing, garment, raiment.
1743: from ἐν and δυναμόω; to empower:--enable, (increase in) strength(-en), be (make) strong.
1744: from ἔννομος and δύνω; to sink (by implication, wrap (compare ἐνδύω) on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak:--creep.
1745: from ἐνδύω; investment with clothing:--putting on.
1746: from ἐν and δύνω (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively):--array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.
1747: feminine from ἐν and the base of ἑδραῖος; an ambuscade, i.e. (figuratively) murderous purpose:--lay wait. See also ἔνεδρον.
1748: from ἐνέδρα; to lurk, i.e. (figuratively) plot assassination:--lay wait for.
1749: neuter of the same as ἐνέδρα; an ambush, i.e. (figuratively) murderous design:--lying in wait.
1750: from ἔννομος and the base of εἱλίσσω; to enwrap:--wrap in.
1751: from ἔννομος and εἰμί; to be within (neuter participle plural):--such things as … have. See also ἔνι.
1752: of uncertain affinity; on account of:--because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that.
1754: from ἐνεργής; to be active, efficient:--do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).
1756: from ἐν and ἔργον; active, operative:--effectual, powerful.
1757: from ἐν and εὐλογέω; to confer a benefit on:--bless.
1758: from ἐν and ἔχω; to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge:--entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.
1759: from a prolonged form of ἐν; properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither:--(t-)here, hither.
1760: from a compound of ἐν and θυμός; to be inspirited, i.e. ponder:--think.
1762: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of ἔνειμι; impersonally, there is in or among:--be, (there) is.
1763: prolongation from a primary (a year); a year:--year.
1764: from ἐν and ἵστημι; to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant:--come, be at hand, present.
1765: from ἐν and ἰσχύω; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively):--strengthen.
1768: from a (tenth) multiple of ἐννέα and ἐννέα itself; ninety-nine:--ninety and nine.
1769: from ἐννεύω; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment:--speechless.
1770: from ἐν and νεύω; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture:--make signs.
1771: from a compound of ἐν and νοῦς; thoughtfulness, i.e. moral understanding:--intent, mind.
1772: from ἐν and νόμος; (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject to:--lawful, under law.
1773: neuter of a compound of ἐν and νύξ; (adverbially) by night:--before day.
1774: from ἐν and οἰκέω; to inhabit (figuratively):--dwell in.
1776: from ἐν and ὀχλέω; to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to annoy:--trouble.
1777: from ἐνέχω; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation):--in danger of, guilty of, subject to.
1778: from ἐντέλλομαι; an injunction, i.e. religious precept:--commandment.
1779: from a compound of ἐν and τάφος; to inswathe with cerements for interment:--bury.
1781: from ἐν and the base of τέλος; to enjoin:--(give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.
1782: from the same as ἐνθάδε; hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides:--(from) hence, on either side.
1783: from ἐντυγχάνω; an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication:--intercession, prayer.
1784: from ἐν and τιμή; valued (figuratively):--dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.
1785: from ἐντέλλομαι; injunction, i.e. an authoritative prescription:--commandment, precept.
1786: from ἐν and τόπος; a resident:--of that place.
1788: from ἐν and the base of τροπή; to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound:--regard, (give) reference, shame.
1789: from ἐν and τρέφω; (figuratively) to educate:--nourish up in.
1790: from ἐν and τρόμος; terrified:--X quake, X trembled.
1792: from ἐν and τρυφάω; to revel in:--sporting selves.
1793: from ἐν and τυγχάνω; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against):--deal with, make intercession.
1794: from ἐν and (to twist; probably akin to εἱλίσσω); to entwine, i.e. wind up in:--wrap in (together).
1795: from ἐν and a derivative of τύπος; to enstamp, i.e. engrave:--engrave.
1796: from ἐν and ὑβρίζω; to insult:--do despite unto.
1797: middle voice from ἐνύπνιον; to dream:--dream(-er).
1798: from ἐν and ὕπνος; something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream):--dream.
1799: neuter of a compound of ἐν and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; in the face of (literally or figuratively):--before, in the presence (sight) of, to.
